services.title: Web App Development
services.description: We built a high-scale clinical research platform and analytical ecosystem for exploring 30M+ drug–disease pairs. The solution includes dynamic filtering, persistent URL-based views, secure role-based access, and automated E2E testing.

services.title: Front-End Development
services.description: We delivered a full website redesign covering search, property pages, and the booking flow. Built with Next.js and Supabase, the solution achieved 95+ Lighthouse scores through performance-first engineering.

services.title: SaaS & B2B/D2C Platforms
services.description: We built an AI-native platform for managing and deploying LLM workflows at scale. The solution structures prompts into versioned assets, supports multiple AI providers, and includes observability, governance, and production safeguards.

services.title: Mobile App Development
services.description: We developed the Trovr and Trovr Merchant mobile ecosystem for a recycling rewards program. The apps support QR/barcode scanning, reward redemption, push notifications, location tracking, deep linking, and synchronization between the consumer and merchant experiences.

services.title: Back-End Development
services.description: We built the backend architecture for a secure quote management platform, replacing spreadsheets with real-time collaboration. The solution features PostgreSQL data models, ERP pricing integrations, server-side calculations, and high-performance APIs.

services.title: AI Integrations
services.description: We built an AI-powered oncology platform using RAG and LLMs to discover, compare, and extract insights from clinical trial data. It combines automated AI workflows with structured exploration for research teams.

services.title: Product Support & Scaling
services.description: We built a scalable multi-tenant recruitment platform for high-volume hiring workflows. It features real-time chat, analytics, automated invitation flows, secure tenant data isolation, and high-reliability architecture.
